create_OcrAutoModel: create an OcrAutoModel instance that auto-selects an OCR engine from ocrmac, rapidocr, or easyocr
run_OcrAutoModel_call: run the OcrAutoModel to process a batch of pages through the auto-selected OCR engine
build_OcrAutoModel_with_options: build an OcrAutoModel with OcrAutoOptions for bitmap area threshold and force full page OCR settings
test_OcrAutoModel_get_options_type: test the OcrAutoModel.get_options_type class method returns OcrAutoOptions
review_OcrAutoModel_engine_selection: review the OcrAutoModel engine selection priority: ocrmac on darwin, rapidocr with onnxruntime, easyocr, rapidocr with torch
